top root/bus_tb.shbench for Ngspice
== root/bus_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  provenance "xschem root/bus_tb.sch"
  xfp be0c2902214cc46f

inst rb41rx ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name X[3:0]
  wn 0.5

wire d68kfn -100 0 -40 0
  bus true
wire m79s18 40 0 100 0
  bus true

label a4jfwv -100 0 R0 din[3:0]
label szpz9e 100 0 R0 dout[0:3]
== root/inv.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem root/inv.sym"
  xfp a4f20ac7bedac797

pin A in -40 0
pin Y out 40 0

param wn 1
param wp 2
param l 0.15

impl schematic schematic
  format spice "{name} {pins} {cell}"

line -40 0 -20 0
  layer 4
line 20 0 40 0
  layer 4

inst dfp34e ./pmos
  at 0 -60 R0
  name MP
  W wp
  L l
inst y287ds ./nmos
  at 0 60 R0
  name MN
  W wn
  L l

wire cgxvbz -20 -60 -20 60
wire cvcx5p -60 0 -20 0
wire f7tqca 20 -30 20 30
wire zq2q34 20 0 60 0

label 1rt9q5 20 60 R0 0
label 6a5y81 20 -60 R0 vdd!
  global true
label damm8g 20 90 R0 0
label f2kfcv 20 -90 R0 vdd!
  global true

port 3cvwgn -60 0 R0 A
port 642gv3 60 0 R0 Y
== root/nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix M
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem root/nmos.sym"
  xfp 61d3fe40784dc67a

pin D inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 30
pin B inout 20 0

param W 1
param L 0.15
param nf 1
param model nfet
  kind string

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W='({W})*1u' L='({L})*1u' nf={nf} ad='(({W})*0.29)*1p'"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W='({W})*1u' L='({L})*1u'"

rect -20 -20 20 20
  layer 4
  fill false

stext -20 -35 R0 {cell}
  size 0.2
  layer 3

impl spice spice
